WARN  lint-session-store-lazy-evict  @DIR@/Mod/src/com/x/DashboardConfigSession.java:9  static session/token map 'SESSIONS' inserted here with no sweep in the SAME method (no scheduled purge found either) -- add a scheduled/size-bounded eviction, or bind auth to user+issue-time rather than the bare container id

-- Mod/src/com/x/DashboardConfigSession.java --
final class DashboardConfigSession
{
  private static final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Entry> SESSIONS =
      new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Entry>();

  static Entry create(String jsessionId, String username)
  {
    Entry entry = new Entry(username);
    SESSIONS.put(jsessionId, entry);
    return entry;
  }

  static void remove(String jsessionId)
  {
    Entry removed = SESSIONS.remove(jsessionId);
  }

  static Entry query(String jsessionId)
  {
    Entry entry = SESSIONS.get(jsessionId);
    if (entry != null) SESSIONS.remove(jsessionId);  // lazy evict
    return entry;
  }
}
